end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Identified flat and curved faces of solids.
Answered 2 of 4 naming attempts without help and 3 of 3 face-description attempts without help.
A brief mix-up about a cylinder’s circular base was corrected during the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying solid shapes in toys and describing their flat or curved faces. Aditya used examples such as a ball, party cap and candle, and explained that a cylinder has two flat circular faces. There was a brief mix-up about the cylinder’s base being both circular and flat; it was corrected and stated correctly again later. At home, ask Aditya to find three objects and name their solid shape and flat or curved faces.
